title: Postdoctoral Positions in FRB, pulsar, Tsinghua University
field: Astronomy: fast radio bursts, pulsar binaries, interstellar and intergalactic medium
about: Tsinghua University's Department of Astronomy recruits postdoctoral researchers to work with Prof. Dongzi Li and Prof. Di Li on fast radio bursts, pulsar binaries, and the interstellar or intergalactic medium, with possible roles in CHIME/FRB, FAST FRB Key Project and DART.
requirements: For observational candidates, experience in pulsar binary data analysis, FRB searches and polarization calibration is particularly desirable

upskill.name: the Data Analytics Academy page
why: "Pulsar binary data analysis" / "FRB searches" → Data Analytics Academy: "Strengthen the statistical, mathematical and analytical foundations needed to interpret data, build reliable analyses" (no single course scored at least 6 with a genuine match; the shortlist was business, spreadsheet and finance analytics, so the post links to the Academy page).
